# HTTP route reference

<!-- Generated by tools/build_code_reference.py; edit source docstrings or the generator. -->

These are literal APIRouter decorators, including their declared prefixes and parameter dependencies. Middleware, router-level dependencies, in-handler checks and service checks also affect access. Absence of require_user in this table is not a claim that an endpoint is public. Static mounts and dynamic URL construction are documented in the owning source.

Return to the [documentation index](../README.md) or [code guide](../CODE_GUIDE.md).
